memories.content: The geography department head has proposed the coastal field trip and needs the principal's sign-off before the half-term deadline. They are aware of the new coach operator and the extra signature requirement from the deputy head, who is on leave.

Petersfield Secondary School has a half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters for the coastal field trip. The trip has run without incident for four years. This year, a new coach operator is being used, and the risk-assessment form requires an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The geography department head can submit the proposal to the principal for sign-off.
